description: Fetch real-time Apple App Store customer reviews for any iOS/macOS app numeric ID (e.g. "324684580" for Spotify or "6448311069" for ChatGPT) across 175+ countries, including star distribution, sentiment polarity, app_version, and helpfulness votes. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

app_id.description: Numeric Apple App Store ID or apps.apple.com URL, e.g. "324684580" or "https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spotify/id324684580".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 App Store storefront country (e.g. "us", "gb", "ca", "au", "jp").

page.description: Feed page (1–10, up to 50 reviews per page).

name: app_store_reviews

data.description: Normalized reviews payload containing target metadata, sentiment_summary (star_distribution and polarity_breakdown), and paginated reviews array.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Extract Apple App Store iOS Customer Reviews & Version Polarity
